patterns.note: Content sections alternate between full-width hero/editorial imagery and structured grid layouts for product displays, maintaining a clean, modular flow.
Impactful, oversized sans-serif headings are used for key section titles and the hero statement, contrasting with smaller, clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A high-contrast monochrome palette of black and white dominates, occasionally softened by subtle off-white or light beige backgrounds for specific content blocks.

Sections and content blocks reveal themselves with a subtle fade-up or slide-up effect as the user scrolls down the page, creating a dynamic content discovery experience. A horizontal text banner scrolls continuously.
Editorial image blocks featuring lifestyle photography are interspersed between product listing grids, adding a narrative and brand-building element to the product-focused page.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero is used at the top of the page, featuring large, multi-line text overlaid directly on the video for immediate brand messaging.
A sticky navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site links as the user scrolls.
Scroll-triggered animations are employed to reveal content: as sections enter the viewport, they animate into place with a subtle upward slide and fade-in effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold display headings (~4-5x body) create strong visual impact, complemented by clean, legible body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — with an airy hero and generous vertical spacing for major headings, transitioning to a more dense footer.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a massive, bold brand logo at the very bottom of the page creates a memorable and strong brand statement. The editorial-style photography and the poetic, multi-line hero text give the site an art-house, luxurious feel that elevates it beyond a typical e-commerce experience.
